content.name: Sneha Joshi
content.title: Senior Business Analyst
content.summary: Senior business analyst with almost ten years in IT services, health insurance and digital lending. Own requirements for a Pune lender's loan origination journey, where a redesigned document flow cut average disbursal time from 4 days to 36 hours. B.E. and MBA, with strong process, data and stakeholder skills.

experience.title: Senior Business Analyst
bullets: Own requirements for the personal loan origination journey handling about 40,000 applications a month.
Redesigned document collection with Aadhaar-based e-KYC and account aggregator consent, cutting average disbursal time from 4 days to 36 hours.
Worked with compliance to translate RBI digital lending guidelines into 120 testable requirements before the deadline.
Guide three business analysts on story slicing and review their specifications.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Gathered requirements for cashless claim pre-authorisation with 600 network hospitals, reducing turnaround from 6 hours to 2.
Mapped the policy renewal process and proposed WhatsApp reminders that improved on-time renewals by 9%.
Led UAT with claims teams across Pune and Hyderabad for three major releases.

experience.title: Associate Business Analyst
bullets: Wrote functional specifications for an inventory module used by a UK retail client, coordinating across time zones.
Created process flows and wireframes that reduced clarification calls with developers by about half.
Prepared weekly status reports for the client delivery manager.
